summary: Phase 3 turns the whole instrument into one serializable state object (EngineState) driven by a single extended PianoAudioEngine. Verified at runtime (dist on 8753): pressing one key created exactly ONE AudioContext and 15 oscillators = piano A (4 harmonics) + organ A B3 (9 partials) + synth A (1 osc) + 1 LFO, alongside 2 convolvers / 2 delays / 6 waveshapers / 3 compressors, all feeding master -> limiter -> one destination. So all three engines share the single context and master path with no second AudioContext. Organ models use genuinely distinct partial banks (B3/Vox/Farf/Pipe, Farf on square) and drawbars multiply partial weights; key click is a real transient. Synth has real biquad filters, amp envelope, LFO routing (filter/pitch), and unison detune. The Program system implements 32 slots + 8 Live slots with Store/Store As naming, dirty 'E' indicator, load/discard, split zones (zoneAllows routes audio by note), two scenes, Wheel/Control-Pedal morph, transpose +/-6, master-clock tap, and Panic. HOWEVER significant completeness gaps remain: (1) Synth source CATEGORIES are not audibly distinct -- waveType() collapses Sync Saw / Multi Saw / Super Saw all to a plain sawtooth and FM 2-op to a sine, so Sync/Multi/Super/FM-H are renamed copies of one oscillator (fails the distinct-source hard gate for the synth). (2) The arpeggiator/gate is not implemented (no scheduler); voice modes (Mono/Legato), glide, and synth vibrato update state but produce no audio behavior. (3) Organ percussion (soft/fast/3rd), vibrato/chorus, and rotary are non-audible -- the rotary effect is never built in the engine at all. (4) Organ and Synth buses route input->level->master and BYPASS the effect chain entirely (effect units are built only for piano A/B), so inherited effects and rotary do not process organ/synth. (5) The Phase 2 parallel-dry-path gain-staging bug persists. (6) Morph destinations are hardcoded (wheel->piano A level, pedal->synth A filter) rather than assignable; scenes only toggle layer enables; split crossfade value is stored but not applied as an audible gain crossfade. Visually the desktop capture is dense but shows some label/control overlap in the Synth and Program areas, and the 390px narrow capture is noticeably crowded with overlapping controls. Console was clean (favicon 404 only). Honesty is well maintained: spec-excluded controls are disclosed in a UI details panel and no recorded-sample provenance is falsely claimed. Candidate tests remain DOM/aria assertions, not real audio-boundary tests, and App.tsx is written as extremely dense single-line components (maintainability concern).

criteria.label: Reference and regression retention
evidence: stage3-desktop.png retains the red chassis, six-section order, keybed, and Program/Synth OLEDs, but shows visible label/control overlap in the Synth footer (Puls/Saw/LP24 overlapping) and Program display area.

stage3-narrow.png (390x844) is heavily crowded: overlapping SUSTPED/drawbar labels, Program dial/buttons, 'STORE AS/SPLIT' and 'Grand Stack' text overflow -- a responsive regression versus the cleaner Phase 1 narrow layout.
Core geometry and inventory are preserved; the drift is in dense-control legibility.

criteria.label: Complete hardware state fidelity
evidence: Programs, splits (SPLIT/points/crossfade), scenes I/II, Wheel/Ctrl-Pedal morph, Organ (models, 9 drawbars w/ LED ladders, perc, key click, vib, rotary), Synth (3 layers, category/waveform, filter, envelopes, LFO, voice/priority/unison/vibrato, arp/direction/range), and Effects all render coherent state from a single EngineState.
Program and Synth remain the only OLED displays; ON/OFF section chips and focus state shown.
Rendering is comprehensive but crowded (see referenceRetention).

criteria.label: Programs and Live Mode
evidence: createInitialEngineState builds 32 named programs + 8 Live slots; App.tsx load/store/scene handle selection, Store/Store As with NAME input + CONFIRM, dirty 'E' indicator, discard-on-load, and Live auto-store to the selected slot.
8 program buttons, PAGE left/right, dial, and LIST toggle present; round-trip via cloneProgramState/applyProgramState.
phase3.test.tsx exercises dirty state, Store toggle, Live Mode, Scene II.
Browsing is somewhat limited (dial maps within the current page of 8).

criteria.label: Layers, splits, scenes, and morphs
evidence: Splits editable from SPLIT_POSITIONS list and audible via zoneAllows note routing; transpose +/-6 applied in noteOn; Panic clears voices and resets morph values; master clock tap/bpm present.

Gaps: morph destinations are hardcoded (wheel->layers.A.level, pedal->synthLayers.A.filterFreq), not user-assignable; scenes only toggle layer enable flags (no per-scene parameter state); split crossfade (0/6/12) is stored but not applied as an audible gain crossfade.
Master clock does not drive any arp (arp unimplemented).

criteria.label: Complete Organ system
evidence: Distinct engines: ORGAN_PARTIALS give B3/Vox/Farf/Pipe distinct partial weights; Farf uses square oscillators; drawbars multiply partial gains (real); keyClick renders a real 2.4kHz transient.
Two layers with enable/focus/level present.
Non-audible gaps: percussion + percussionSoft/Fast/Third have no audio effect in createOrgan; vibrato/chorus unused in audio; rotary toggle does nothing (no rotary node in the engine).

criteria.label: Complete Synth system
evidence: Real: three layers, biquad filter per type (LP12/LP24/HP/BP), amp attack/release envelope, LFO to Filter Freq / Osc Pitch, unison detune, White Noise via BufferSource.

Category failure: waveType() maps Sync Saw/Multi Saw/Super Saw all to 'sawtooth' and FM 2-op to 'sine' -- Sync/Multi/Super/FM-H are not distinct synthesis methods (no hard sync, no supersaw stack unless unison>0, no FM).
Arpeggiator/Gate is not implemented (no scheduling in the engine); voiceMode Mono/Legato, glide, and vibrato update state but have no audio effect.
Osc/filter envelope stages (oscAttack/filterAttack etc.) are largely unused beyond the amp envelope.

criteria.label: Distinct engine behavior
evidence: Organ models verified distinct via ORGAN_PARTIALS arrays (B3 full harmonic set, Vox/Farf hollow/odd emphasis, Pipe rolloff) and Farf square wave.
Piano PROFILE and organ banks differ meaningfully; runtime showed 9 organ oscillators vs 4 piano.
Synth source families are NOT distinct: Sync/Multi/Super collapse to sawtooth and FM to sine (waveType), i.e. renamed copies of one oscillator -- fails the synth half of the distinct-source gate.

criteria.label: Inherited graph and effects integration
evidence: Verified single AudioContext for piano+organ+synth (runtime probe: ctx=1) with master gain -> limiter -> one destination.
Per-section/layer buses (piano-A/B, organ-A/B, synth-A/B/C) all connect to master.

Effects units are built ONLY for piano A/B; organ and synth route input->level->master and bypass the inherited effect chain and rotary entirely -- so shared effects/targeting/Rotary do NOT apply to organ/synth.
Parallel-dry-path gain bug from Phase 2 persists in the piano chain.

criteria.label: Musical quality, latency, and load
evidence: 36-voice oldest-first stealing; releaseVoice disconnects with setTimeout; dispose closes context; limiter guards clipping; no console errors at runtime.
Split/layered play works; envelopes give click-free attacks/releases.
Quality caveat: default state enables piano+organ+synth layer A simultaneously, so a single key stacks three engines (dense/muddy default), and arp timing is absent.

criteria.label: Canonical state round-trip
evidence: ProgramState (EngineState minus programs/live/dirty/selected/store/liveMode/activeScene/morph/clock/transpose) is cloned on store and re-applied on load, restoring piano/organ/synth/effects/split/scenes/focus/levels/types.
applyProgramState deep-clones and merges; dirty reset on load.
Excluded from round-trip: morph assignments, master clock, and transpose are not saved per program.

criteria.label: Required hardware bindings
evidence: Most controls are bound to canonical EngineState and update display/state; spec-excluded controls (preset library, Extern/Aux KB, aftertouch morph, Num Pad, pattern editing, MIDI-out, Shift menus, pedal tap) are disclosed in a UI details panel.
But several non-excluded controls have UI state with NO audible behavior: synth arp/gate, voice modes, glide, synth vibrato; organ percussion, vibrato/chorus, rotary; split crossfade amount.
These are honest (not fake success) but fall short of the 'meaningful canonical AND audible behavior' requirement for required controls.

criteria.label: Cross-system workflows
evidence: Single EngineState + single engine unify layers, zones/splits, scenes, morphs, transpose, clock, focus, and displays; programs serialize the whole system.
Runtime confirmed one key drives piano+organ+synth together through one context.
Integration weakened by organ/synth bypassing the effect chain and arp being absent.

criteria.label: Inherited regression reliability
evidence: Inherited Phase 1/2 behavior retained: keybed inputs, piano library, effect chain on piano, sustain/blur cleanup, single context; phase2.test.tsx and App.test.tsx carried forward.
Console clean at runtime (favicon 404 only); stage3-capture.json consoleMessages/pageErrors empty.
Minor regression: narrow (390px) layout is crowded with overlapping controls.

criteria.label: System architecture
evidence: Canonical state ownership in EngineState; one-context routing; effect composition via UnitRuntime; serialization via clone/applyProgramState; proven extensible from Phase 2.
Weaknesses: organ/synth not integrated into the effect graph; no rotary node; platform APIs not injectable.
Engine boundaries (createTone/createOrgan/createSynth) are clear.

criteria.label: Tests and maintainability
evidence: phase3.test.tsx (37 lines), phase2.test.tsx, App.test.tsx assert only DOM/aria state; no real audio-boundary tests for engines/routing/bypass/cleanup.
App.tsx is written as extremely dense single-line components (each section a ~1-line function), which is hard to read/maintain.
Required-control coverage in tests is partial; many audio behaviors (arp, distinct synth categories) are untested and unimplemented.

criteria.label: Runtime performance
evidence: Runtime console clean; single AudioContext; 36-voice cap; releaseVoice/dispose cleanup; stable rendering at 1440 and 390.
Rapid integrated interaction (key + program/scene changes) stable in testing.
Default triple-engine stacking increases per-note voice/CPU load.

issues: Distinct-source hard gate partially failed: synth Sync/Multi/Super categories all render as a plain sawtooth and FM 2-op as a sine (waveType collapses them) -- renamed copies of one oscillator; organ models are genuinely distinct.
Arpeggiator/Gate is unimplemented (no scheduler); synth voice modes (Mono/Legato), glide, and vibrato, and organ percussion/vibrato-chorus/rotary update state but produce no audible behavior.
Organ and Synth buses bypass the inherited effect chain and rotary entirely (effects built only for piano A/B), so shared effects/Rotary do not process organ/synth.

Performance systems are shallow: morph destinations hardcoded (not assignable), scenes only toggle layer enables, split crossfade stored but not audibly applied; morph/clock/transpose not saved per program.
Phase 2 parallel-dry-path gain-staging bug persists; narrow (390px) layout is crowded with overlapping controls; candidate tests assert DOM state only, not the audio backend.
